entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Founder and first high priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand on Sarpadia, a necromancer later deified as a god of lies.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The order founded by Tourach that deified him.

entities.name: Ebon Praetor
entities.description: The being Tourach worshiped instead of the Hand of Justice.

entities.name: Hand of Justice
entities.description: The being most people worshiped at the time.

entities.name: Leitbur
entities.description: Deity whose followers dreaded Tourach's return.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: An immortal warrior in whom Tourach is said to have incarnated, hunted down by Farrel's followers.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Icatian zealot whose followers hunted down and killed Tymolin.

entities.name: Vetro
entities.description: A Neo-Ebonic priest-king said to be a reincarnation of Tourach.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Followers of Oliver Farrel who called Tourach the False God.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The continent where the Ebon Hand was founded.

events.summary: Tourach established a new empire with its capital at Achtep Keep, using sacrifice-based necromancy and maddening chants.
On Tourach's death the Ebon Hand deified him as a god of lies.
events.quote: the members of the Ebon Hand deified him

events.summary: Oliver Farrel had his followers hunt down and kill Tymolin Loneglade, an incarnation of Tourach.
events.quote: had his followers hunt her down and kill her

relations.note: He was its founder and first high priest.
relations.quote: was the founder and first high priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand

relations.note: He had his followers hunt her down and kill her.
